limits: Official-game roster coverage is not a complete historical archival OOB audit.
Matching name/nationality/type/suffix is not proof that an arrival activates correctly.
Air groups are separate from the ground/HQ/airbase table; audit separately.
Do not blanket activate reserves, split placeholders, duplicate identities or unscheduled units.
Static source schedule and structure verification only; new natural1944-45 arrivals and manpower event delivery require runtime validation.
The remaining deferred roster records are audited separately, not all activated. Three railway groups are restored using official scenario dates, not newly established archival identities.
Existing AI, shared-pool and long-campaign limitations remain.
